name: Slides
description: Make and revise presentation decks. The agent writes 1920×1080 slides as HTML, checks the layout in a real browser, and exports a self-contained HTML deck with a presenter view, a PDF, or a PowerPoint file.
examples: Turn these meeting notes into an eight-slide deck for Thursday's team update.
Make a ten-slide investor pitch for our product from the README, then export it as PDF.
Make slides 3 and 5 of my deck less crowded and give them speaker notes.

zh-CN.name: 幻灯片
zh-CN.description: 制作和修改演示文稿。agent 用 HTML 写 1920×1080 的幻灯片，在真实浏览器里检查版面，导出可离线放映的网页（带演讲者备注）、PDF 或 PowerPoint 文件。
examples: 把这份会议纪要整理成周四团队例会用的 8 页幻灯片。
根据 README 给我们的产品做一份 10 页的融资路演 PPT，再导出 PDF。
把我这份幻灯片的第 3、5 页改得不那么挤，并加上演讲备注。
